dropZone.prompt: Drop files or an archive here
dropZone.a11yLabel: Drop files or archives to compress or extract
dropZone.a11yHint: Press Enter to choose files instead

compress.title: Compress
compress.nameRequired: Enter a name for the archive.

extract.title: Extract
extract.autoFolderNote: Archives with loose files are placed in a new folder named after the archive.

settings.title: Settings
settings.verboseLoggingNote: Writes a detailed debug log for bug reports. Logs stay on this device — attach them to a GitHub issue yourself if you choose.
settings.readOnlyWarning: Settings were written by a newer version of Squash and are read-only.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Squash
onboarding.intro: A fast, no-nonsense file compressor. Pick your language and theme — you can change both later in Settings.
onboarding.defaultHandler: Make Squash the default app for archives
onboarding.defaultHandlerNote: Your operating system controls this choice, so Squash can't flip it for you — it can only take you to the right place.
onboarding.manualSteps: On macOS: select an archive in Finder → Get Info → Open with → Squash → Change All. On Linux: set Squash as the archive handler in your desktop's settings or file manager.
onboarding.dropHint: Tip: drop files or an archive anywhere in this window to get started.

errors.corrupt_archive: This archive is corrupt — copy or download it again.
errors.path_traversal_blocked: This archive tried to write outside the destination folder and was blocked.
errors.permission_denied: Permission denied — check the folder's permissions.
errors.disk_full: Disk full — free some space, then Retry.
errors.password_required: This archive is encrypted. Squash v1 can't open encrypted archives.
errors.decompression_bomb: This archive expands to a suspicious size or entry count and was stopped as a safety precaution.
